semantic_contracts: collector cursor advances only after canonical write durability
findings and evidence keep stable event/entity identifiers
full source event is recoverable with exact SHA-256 round-trip
no event payload is stored in acceptance evidence

reserved_migrations.name: storage_v2_foundation
reserved_migrations.purpose: dark V2 schema, archive manifest and checkpoint tables

reserved_migrations.name: storage_v2_backfill_support
reserved_migrations.purpose: transactional outbox, comparison and progress state

reserved_migrations.name: storage_v2_runtime_routing
reserved_migrations.purpose: feature flags and grants for controlled read/write transition

archive_contract.event_codec: deterministic gzip JSONL canonical event rows
archive_contract.link_detail_codec: deterministic gzip JSONL canonical link details
atomic_publish: write manifest record in staging state
atomic rename .partial to immutable final name
mark manifest published in a separate idempotent transaction
archive_contract.failure_rule: staging or hash-mismatched blocks are never served and are retried or quarantined
security: archive ACL limited to service identity, administrators and authorized information-security operators
archive paths and event content are never persisted in acceptance evidence

capacity_contract.minimum_free_space_formula: max(1.10 * current_database_bytes, projected_v2_database_bytes + projected_archive_bytes + latest_verified_dump_bytes + 0.35 * current_database_bytes)
capacity_contract.wal_gate: implementation benchmark must measure WAL per migrated event and prove max_wal_size/checkpoint headroom before live backfill
capacity_contract.external_copy_gate: verified off-host or off-volume copy of the latest production dump and manifest is mandatory before live migration

phases.name: preflight_and_recovery_boundary
phases.rollback: no production change; reject implementation package

phases.name: dark_schema_install
production_actions: apply only versioned migrations 9-10
create dark V2 objects and grants
leave runtime read/write modes at v1
required_gates: rollback SQL tested on disposable database
phases.rollback: drop only empty V2 objects through versioned rollback before any backfill

phases.name: bounded_backfill
production_actions: capture immutable high watermark H0=max(events.id)
backfill id ranges in restartable chunks
publish verified archive blocks
checkpoint every committed chunk
phases.rollback: stop worker; keep V1 authoritative; remove only unpublished/quarantined V2 artifacts through separate cleanup gate

phases.name: transactional_outbox_and_tail_catchup
production_actions: atomically commit V1 batch and storage_v2_outbox identity
advance collector cursor after V1 plus outbox commit
asynchronously build V2/archive idempotently
tail backfill H0+1 through activation watermark H1
phases.rollback: disable outbox flag; continue V1 collection; retain queued identities for later replay

phases.name: shadow_dual_read
production_actions: serve V1 responses
run bounded shadow V2 queries
compare semantic hashes and latency without returning V2 to user
required_gates: core query p95 no more than 20 percent slower than V1
minimum 24-hour observation or approved equivalent deterministic workload
phases.rollback: set read mode v1; shadow state may be discarded

phases.name: v2_read_cutover
production_actions: switch read mode from shadow to v2
keep V1 authoritative write plus outbox
monitor findings, reports, timelines and detail lookup
phases.rollback: single flag returns reads to V1; no data conversion required

phases.name: v2_primary_write_canary
production_actions: publish archive and V2 core as canonical batch
advance cursor only after V2 durability
maintain bounded V1 compatibility mirror during rollback window
phases.rollback: return to V1 only while compatibility parity is complete; otherwise stop collection and replay immutable archive/raw spool into V1

phases.name: dr_and_decommission_gate
production_actions: perform V2 database plus archive restore drill
freeze V1 after rollback window
decommission only through a separate destructive approval
phases.rollback: no automatic DROP; preserve verified V1 backup and frozen schema until decommission acceptance

global_stop_conditions: production fingerprint changes outside approved objects
any missing or duplicated event id
archive SHA mismatch or unpublished block served

rollback_matrix.action: versioned rollback of empty V2 schema
stop V2 workers; V1 remains authoritative
rollback only with complete V1 mirror parity, else stop and replay
restore verified V1 backup only through disaster-recovery procedure

acceptance_evidence_contract.detailed_logs: temporary and referenced by hashes only
